testcase.name: support-lifecycle/aks/1.34
testcase.system-out: warning: Kubernetes 1.34 leaves Azure Kubernetes Service standard support on 2026-11-30. Azure Kubernetes Service ends standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-11-30; the cluster then moves to extended support until 2027-11-30, when Azure Kubernetes Service stops supporting it. Fix: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support. References: - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/supported-kubernetes-versions
